Treasure reference 2018 T764: three late Roman silver siliquae . 1. A Roman silver silique of Valens (AD 364-378), dating to the period AD 367-375 (Reece Period 19). VRBS-ROMA reverse type depicting Roma seated facing left, on throne, holding Victory on globe and sceptre. Mint of Trier. RIC 27e / 45b. Obverse description: Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust, right. Obverse inscription: DN VALEN-S PF AVG. Reverse description: Roma seated facing left, on throne, holding Victory on globe and sceptre. Reverse inscription: VRBS-ROMA. Mint mark: TRPS - Mint of Trier. Date: AD 367-375 (Reece Period 19).
